glosses: To obtain money or property from (a person) by fraud; to swindle.

examples.text: I had never defrauded a man of a farthing, nor called him knave behind his back. But now the last rag that covered my nakedness had been torn from me. I was branded a blackleg, card-sharper, and murderer.

examples.text: The two men swindled the company out of $160,000.

examples.text: She swindled more than £200 out of me.
